title: Blink-182, Korn, MGK, Alice in Chains, The Offspring to Play 2027 Welcome to Rockville Festival
summary: More than 150 acts are lined up for the four-day rock fest in Daytona Beach, Fla. from May 6-9.
contentText:
The 2027 lineup for the Welcome to Rockville festival features more than 150 artists, including headliners Blink-182, MGK, Korn, Alice in Chains, Bad Omens, $uicideboy$, Ice Nine Kills, Pierce the Veil, the Offspring, Good Charlotte and Faith No More’s first North American show since their 2016 hiatus.

The four-day (May 6-9) event at the Daytona International Speedway in Daytona Beach, Fla. from promoter Danny Wimmer Presents will also feature sets from The Prodigy, Marilyn Manson, Knocked Loose, Judas Priest, Danzig, Bilmuri, Circa Survive, I Prevail, Rammstein singer Till Lindemann, Cypress Hill, 311, Stone Temple Pilots and Skid Row’s first show in three years, a celebration of their 40th anniversary that will be their first gig with newly announced vocalist Justin Sargent.

In addition to more than 150 artists on five stages, the 16th annual festival announced some upgrades, including the addition of panoramic video and immersive production on the Apex stage, upgraded visuals on the Octane stage, a larger footprint and additional full shade at the Vortex stage as well as upgraded video and audio at the Inferno stage, which this year will be moved into a tent. In addition to the three tented stages, promoters highlighted more shade, covered bleachers, more seating and umbrellas across the event’s footprint.

Among the other acts slated to perform are: Papa Roach, Seether, Hot Mulligan, The Pretty Reckless, Poppy, Lil Jon, Bullet For My Valentine, She Wants Revenge, Meshuggah, Boys Like Girls, Black Veil Brides, Dashboard Confessional, Cobra Starship, Rico Nasty, Machine Head, Coal Chamber, Sleep Theory, Sugar Ray, Everlast, Testament, Escape The Fate, Waka Flocka Flame, P.O.D., Forever The Sickest Kids, B.o.B, Kittie, Hey Monday, Of Mice & Men, Steel Panther, Eve 6 and many more.
